text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s i-n t-h-e e-d-i-t-o-r-i-a-l p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r-a-t-i-o-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a a-n-d i-p a-d-d-r-e-s-s l-o-g-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-n-d i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d p-r-e-d-e-t-e-r-m-i-n-e-d a-c-c-e-p-t-a-n-c-e d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n-s f-o-r t-h-e-i-r o-w-n p-a-p-e-r-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g f-o-r-g-e-d r-e-v-i-e-w f-i-l-e-s i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m a-r-c-h-i-v-e, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e r-a-n-d-o-m a-s-s-i-g-n-m-e-n-t a-n-d b-l-i-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w c-o-n-t-r-o-l c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d n-e-g-a-t-i-v-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s t-o r-e-j-e-c-t a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n, d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e t-e-c-h-n-i-c-a-l c-l-a-i-m-s i-n t-h-e r-e-v-i-e-w t-e-x-t, w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e o-b-j-e-c-t-i-v-i-t-y s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d a-n-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r w-e-i-g-h-t-e-d t-h-e f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s h-i-g-h-e-r t-h-a-n l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e o-n-e-s i-n t-h-e f-i-n-a-l d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n, a-l-t-e-r-i-n-g t-h-e e-d-i-t-o-r i-a-l w-e-i-g-h-t-i-n-g a-l-g-o-r-i-t-h-m, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w q-u-a-l-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t a-n-d i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-v-o-k-e-d s-y-s-t-e-m v-u-l-n-e-r-a-b-i-l-i-t-i-e-s t-o m-a-k-e t-h-e p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m c-o-n-s-i-d-e-r t-h-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n d l-o-g e-n-t-r-y m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-t-i-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n a-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r n-e-t-w-o-r-k a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s c-h-e-c-k.
